Per-Chromosome Imprinting Survey of a Cohort

Source: R/module_scoring.R
Survey_Global_Imprinting_Batch.Rd

Applies the per-chromosome survey of Survey_Global_Imprinting() to every sample.

Usage

Survey_Global_Imprinting_Batch(
  betaFile,
  metaFile = NULL,
  subset = "all",
  probeset = c("selected", "NanoImprint", "Joshi", "Court", "Rosenski", "Jima",
    "chr11p15", "chr20q13"),
  min_probes = 10,
  ids_cutoff = 0.2,
  genome = "hg38"
)

Arguments

betaFile

Beta matrix, data frame or file path (probes by samples).

metaFile

Metadata data frame or file path with Sample_Name.

subset

"all" (default) or one chromosome (for example "chr11") to survey.

probeset

Probeset panel (default "selected").

min_probes

Minimum number of probes of a parental class on a chromosome; with fewer, that class's median is set to 0.5 (default 10). Chromosomes with fewer in both classes are dropped.

ids_cutoff

IDS cutoff for the Status column (default 0.2).

genome

Genome build of the probeset annotation, "hg19" or "hg38" (default).

Value

Data frame with one row per sample and chromosome: Sample_Name, Sample_Group and ID2 when available, Chromosome, n_mat, n_pat, IDS, Status, Mechanism and Angle.
